metadata.subject: The STM32G030x6/x8 mainstream microcontrollers are based on high-performance Arm®Cortex®-M0+ 32-bit RISC core operating at up to 64MHz frequency. Offering a high level of integration, they are suitable for a wide range of applications in consumer, industrial and appliance domains and ready for the Internet of Things (IoT) solutions.
